stemMarkdown: Which of the following pairs can never be selected together?
solutionMarkdown:
The fourth condition rules out **Q and U** directly.

Every other option is achievable: P and Q in $\{P, Q, R\}$, R and T in $\{Q, R, T\}$, P and R in $\{P, Q, R\}$, R and U in $\{R, T, U\}$.

R and S is also a forbidden pair, but it is not among the options — check each option against the conditions rather than stopping at the first prohibition you remember.
